Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. Add that they laughed while pretending, so the scene feels more lively and shows why other visitors might be unhappy. e.g. 他们一边笑，一边装祭拜。
2. Add a short thought or spoken line from his mother to show that she worries about the trouble this place may cause. e.g. 妈妈想：“这儿麻烦太多了，我们得搬家。”

ideas.reason: This adds a lively, plausible detail to the children’s pretend funeral game.
It does not clearly connect the mother’s concern to living too close to the cemetery.
